title: Verify financial report totals match sum of line items
gherkin:
Feature: Financial Report Accuracy
  Scenario: Total amount equals sum of all line items
    Given a financial report with multiple line items
    When the report is generated
    Then the total amount should equal the sum of all line items
    And the calculation should be accurate to two decimal places
rationale: Financial reports must have accurate totals that match the sum of their components. This is a fundamental accuracy requirement.
generationSummary: Financial report accuracy rule - Test suite covering validation of financial report data accuracy, calculation correctness, and data integrity across various financial reporting scenarios.

title: Validate currency amounts are correctly formatted
gherkin:
Feature: Financial Report Accuracy
  Scenario: Currency amounts display with correct decimal places
    Given a financial report with currency amounts
    When the report is displayed
    Then all currency amounts should display with exactly two decimal places
    And no rounding errors should be present
rationale: Financial reports must display currency amounts with proper formatting to ensure accuracy and compliance with accounting standards.

title: Ensure debit and credit entries balance
gherkin:
Feature: Financial Report Accuracy
  Scenario: Debit and credit totals balance in accounting report
    Given a financial report with debit and credit entries
    When the report is finalized
    Then the total debits should equal the total credits
    And the report should show a balanced state
rationale: Fundamental accounting principle requires debits to equal credits. Financial reports must enforce this accuracy rule.

title: Verify percentage calculations are accurate

    Given a financial report containing percentage calculations
    When the percentages are computed
    Then each percentage should be accurate to at least two decimal places
    And the calculation method should be consistent throughout the report

title: Validate no duplicate transactions in report
gherkin:
Feature: Financial Report Accuracy
  Scenario: Financial report contains no duplicate transactions
    Given a financial report with multiple transactions
    When the report is generated
    Then no transaction should appear more than once
    And each transaction ID should be unique within the report
rationale: Duplicate transactions would compromise financial report accuracy. The system must prevent and detect duplicates.

title: Ensure date fields are valid and consistent

Feature: Financial Report Accuracy
  Scenario: All dates in financial report are valid and consistent
    Given a financial report with date fields
    When the report is validated
    Then all dates should be in valid format (YYYY-MM-DD)
    And transaction dates should not exceed the report period end date

title: Verify account balances match source data

Feature: Financial Report Accuracy
  Scenario: Account balances in report match source system data

    When the report is created
    Then each account balance should match the corresponding balance in the source system
    And any variance should be zero or documented
